# Avsnitt 195 – I Can but Will I?

**Feed**: kvalitetsaktiepodden  
**Published**: 2026-08-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Negative

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Kvalitetsaktiepodden returns after the summer and warns about US market excess. Their evidence is record-low cash levels among fund managers, a Shiller P/E near its dot-com peak, record margin debt, rising long-term rates and possible overinvestment in AI, so the hosts favour keeping some cash ahead of a possibly volatile autumn. They note that Swedish quality small and mid caps have badly lagged large-cap and tech indices in 2026. On companies, they sold out of Fenix Outdoor and AJ after a weak Q2 and a heavily debt-financed acquisition. They criticise how transparent Björn Borg and Betsson are, and they discuss Telenor's bid for Bahnhof and the problems Betsson faces in Turkey.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 FOI-B — Fenix Outdoor | **SELL** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Weak Q2 ended hopes of a turnaround; the firm sold its small watch position.

#### Reasoning

Q2 sales and profit clearly worse, driven by a weak, price-driven German market, weather and campaigns. ERP and logistics costs keep rising. The earlier signs of improvement faded, so the hosts sold their watch position and see the turnaround as more uncertain. They still note brand value (Fjällräven) could exceed the market cap.

#### Sell Triggers

- if sales and margins show a clear recovery
- if the company unlocks brand value, e.g. by selling Fjällräven

> *"Vi sålde den lilla bevakningspost vi hade. Alldeles för dåligt. Och nu är vändningen än mer osäker."*

---

### 🔴 BORG — Björn Borg | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host halved his personal holding after Q2 sales fell 12% and the company disclosed too little; the firm owns none.

#### Reasoning

Q2 sales -12%, the first decline since Q2 2022, with wholesale weak. The timing-effect explanation came late. No guidance on the order book for next year. The company dropped currency-neutral gross margin reporting, and hosts see cherry-picking. Gross margin 56.2% and EBIT +11% soften this, but H1 sales were flat against a growth target. The personal position was halved and kept in the pension account.

#### Sell Triggers

- if sales growth resumes and order intake with large retailers recovers
- if transparency improves (order book, currency-neutral margin)

> *"Jag blev lite sur här, så jag minskade ner mitt tidigare stora innehav i Borg ganska ordentligt, med hälften ungefär."*

---

### ⛔ BETS-B — Betsson | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Staying on the sidelines despite a P/E of ~10; Turkey B2B risk and poor transparency; tough comparisons in Q3/Q4.

#### Reasoning

Q2 beat expectations and B2B revenue was only -4% from Q1, but -35% y/y. Realm (the main B2B client) collapsed as Turkey cracked down, and Turkish prosecutors are targeting Malta-based infrastructure providers. The World Cup helps Q3, but Q3/Q4 profits will likely fall. Revenue of the acquired Ryan Entertainment was not disclosed. The hosts want more clarity first but have not given up long term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Betsson discloses that no B2B client exceeds ~15% of revenue
- if B2B revenue stabilises and transparency improves
- if Turkey exposure shrinks enough to make a takeover likely

> *"Vi har i alla fall landat, vi vill fortsätta stå vid sidan om i Betsson."*

---

### 🟡 BAHN-B — Bahnhof | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Telenor bid of SEK 62 vs price ~59.60; small arbitrage with a 4-8 month competition review, which should pass given the Telia/Bredband2 precedent.

#### Reasoning

Telenor holds 57% of capital and 88% of votes and is bidding SEK 62. The host expects competition approval because Telia was allowed to buy Bredband2. The gap to the stock price offers modest arbitrage, but payment takes months. The host holds personally but is disappointed with the premium.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the competition authority blocks the deal
- if the bid is withdrawn

> *"Det finns lite arbitrage, men man får vänta på pengarna ett tag."*

---

### ⛔ 000660.KS — SK Hynix | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Memory makers' profits are inflated by cyclically high prices; new fabs should bring prices down.

#### Reasoning

The host argues memory is a cyclical, not especially advanced, product. The large capacity build-out will push prices and profits down, which is why P/E is only ~4-5. The same view applies to Samsung.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory prices stay elevated structurally

> *"Det är en cyklisk bransch. Det är inte världens mest avancerade produkter."*
